security_audit.summary: All 146 static alerts are false positives caused by scanning defensive documentation, signatures, detector source, or Markdown syntax as payload behavior. The scanner makes no network requests or secret reads, but archive extraction lacks resource limits and permits disk exhaustion.

remediation.issue: Skill archives can consume excessive disk space during extraction.
remediation.suggestion: Inspect archive metadata before extraction and reject excessive file counts, per-file sizes, total uncompressed size, or compression ratios.

semantic_findings.title: Unbounded Archive Extraction
semantic_findings.description: Untrusted skill archives are extracted without limits on file count, uncompressed size, or compression ratio. A decompression bomb can exhaust disk space.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly calls extractall on a user-selected archive with no resource checks. This creates a clear local denial-of-service risk.

content.user_title: Audit AI Agent Skills Before Installation
content.value_statement: Unvetted agent skills can hide prompt injection, credential theft, persistence, or unsafe dependencies. This skill combines offline scanning with guided semantic review.
actual_capabilities: Scans local skill folders, manifests, and skill archives.
Detects risky text and code with regular expressions and Python AST analysis.
Tracks selected source-to-sink flows for secrets, files, network input, and execution.
Applies bundled YARA signatures through native YARA or a Python fallback.
Produces terminal, Markdown, structured, and SARIF reports with risk scores.
Guides a contract review between declared purpose and observed behavior.
limitations: Performs static analysis and does not execute or sandbox the target skill.
Cannot fully inspect encrypted payloads, image text, or runtime-only control flow.
English-focused prompt injection patterns may miss attacks in other languages.
Archive extraction currently lacks decompression resource limits.

use_cases.title: Vet a Downloaded Skill
use_cases.description: Review a local skill before granting it access to developer files and tools.

use_cases.title: Review Marketplace Submissions
use_cases.description: Triage submitted skills and investigate high-risk findings before publication.

use_cases.title: Add Security Checks to CI
use_cases.description: Generate SARIF findings for skill repositories during automated validation.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Folder Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the skill at [local path]. Explain whether it is safe to install and cite each confirmed finding.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner wants a clear assessment of one local skill.

prompt_templates.title: Archive Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Scan [archive path] and separate confirmed risks from false positives. Include practical remediation for each confirmed issue.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer received a skill archive from an external source.

prompt_templates.title: Contract and Behavior Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [skill path]. Compare its declared purpose with filesystem, network, environment, and command behavior. Highlight any mismatch.
prompt_templates.scenario: A reviewer needs semantic analysis beyond scanner scores.

prompt_templates.title: Marketplace Release Assessment
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a publication audit of [skill path]. Review all executable files, assess supply-chain risks, and provide a concise release recommendation.
prompt_templates.scenario: A security team needs an advanced prepublication decision.

output_examples.input: Audit a documentation skill that contains no scripts or external dependencies.
output: Verdict: likely safe after manual review.
The declared purpose matches the observed Markdown-only behavior.
No confirmed credential, network, persistence, or execution findings were found.

output_examples.input: Audit a skill whose script reads environment secrets and sends them to an unknown endpoint.
output: A confirmed secret-to-network flow creates a credential exfiltration risk.
Remove the transmission behavior and rotate any exposed credentials.

output_examples.input: Audit a build skill that invokes a fixed compiler command.
output: The command invocation supports the declared build purpose and uses fixed arguments.
Confirm dependency integrity and restrict writable paths before installation.

best_practices: Scan an immutable local copy before installing or executing the target skill.
Read every flagged file and all executable files before deciding the verdict.
Treat scanner output as evidence and verify intent, data flow, and declared behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not publish a skill solely because its numeric score is low.
Do not execute suspicious scripts to determine what they do.
Do not dismiss quoted prompt injection without checking its surrounding context.

faq.question: Does this skill execute the target?
faq.answer: No. It reads local files and performs static analysis only.

faq.question: Which target formats are supported?
faq.answer: It accepts a skill directory, a SKILL.md file, or a zip-based skill archive.

faq.question: Does it require network access?
faq.answer: No. The bundled scanner operates offline and uses local rules.

faq.question: Why is manual review still required?
faq.answer: Pattern matches cannot reliably determine intent or distinguish necessary behavior from abuse.

faq.question: Can it produce CI-compatible results?
faq.answer: Yes. The scanner supports SARIF output for compatible code scanning systems.

faq.question: Does a clean result guarantee safety?
faq.answer: No. Encrypted content, runtime behavior, image text, and unfamiliar injection language can evade static detection.
